meta.method: Mix of direct page fetches (WebFetch) of brand and retailer product/category pages, and WebSearch result snippets that quoted an exact price from the cited domain when a direct fetch was blocked (403/parse errors on several brand sites: reebok.com, asics.com, hoka.com, vans.com, newbalance.com, newbalance.ca, autry-usa.com, lacoste.com). Regular price is the non-sale price as shown; salePrice is filled only when a markdown was explicitly shown alongside a regular price on the same listing.
dropped: Hummel: hummel.net only displayed EUR prices in every search result; no US or CA dollar price page could be confirmed.
Li-Ning: no official lining.com/li-ning.com US or CA price page surfaced; only third-party reseller (shopnings.com, eBay) prices were available, not a brand or recognized major-retailer page.
Feiyue: feiyue-shoes.com showed GBP pricing only in search results; no US or CA dollar price page could be confirmed, and feiyue.us did not resolve to a readable price page.
corrections: 2026-10-05, on review: the ASICS GEL-KAYANO 20 (a 2013 model, its price unexplained), the Allbirds Tree Runner Go (a release price, not a shelf price), the Mizuno Wave Inspire 20 (a review site's $110 against a $150 list), the Jordan Tatum 3 (a secondary summary of nike.com) and the Saucony Triumph 22 (a cited retail price, no page) were 5 dropped; 43 prices read from a search engine's snippet marked unconfirmed.
